nature_language: 当前位置广州。我一个人想去北京玩3天，预算7000人民币，坐火车往返，住一间单床房，麻烦给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Guangzhou. I want to travel alone to Beijing for 3 days with a budget of 7,000 RMB. I plan to take the train round-trip and stay in a single room. Could you please provide me with a travel itinerary?
